newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices track U.S. treasuries up.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices track U.S. treasuries up.

text.p: Danish bond prices on Wednesday shrugged off earlier unease over the snap French elections and instead folowed the United States market upward.
"We expect on Wednesday a relatively calm market at these slighty increased prices," a dealer said.
At 0700 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 109.44, yielding 6.56 percent, up 0.28 point from Tuesday.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 73 basis points. The crown was barely changed, at 3.8110 to the mark compared to Tuesday's 3.8105.
